player_prompt.intro:
D akken d Player {player_id} di JoJoJoin, yurar ɣef usebter 5x5 s yicellen izenzen 0-24.
Di tawmirt-ik, sers iman-ik ɣef yal ticelt tarumit, amedya '[12]'.
TECMUḌAḌ s tifelwit n rebɛa iman-ik s uḍil — rebɛa ticelliwin tuffɣin tafat, neɣ s azɣar neɣ s uɣir.
Akken d Player {player_id} d akken '{symbol}'; amsebrak-ik d '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ahil-nni i d-tefkaḍ ur yeṭṭafar ara anagraw iṣeḥḥa.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} mačči d tazeqqa tamegdayt. Ilaq ad yili gar 0 akked 24.
